title: Cops Take Down FBI Agent’s Son for Murder
description:
Bodycam shows the moments two New Mexico men were arrested in Albuquerque in connection with the death of a young teen, with one suspect being the son of an FBI agent. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.

Grounded in expert narration and insightful commentary from a trusted journalist and attorney, each episode of BodyCam features high-stakes situations with expert analysis.
